note: State A: the account holds zero cards and no decks. Nothing here writes a card or a deck, so both widths see the same state; clearAbout marks the About gate seen and restores it after, so run it on a scratch branch too. Needs COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true, NO_COLLECTION_ENTRY_ENABLED=true and PRECONS_ENABLED=true for the reader. The sheet keeps no fixtures of its own, so each file is one account state and is run on a FRESH account: a scratch branch made from local-dev, prepared as the file says, and deleted after. Steps press only controls inside <main>: the nav's locked-slot note is opened from the shell and is pinned by the nav tests. S4 (pending), S6, S7 and S11 (refusals) and the switch-off states (S15, S16) cannot be forced from a browser and are proved by component tests. The ways group's shared-component check is no-collection-entry-shared.json.
